source.title: European Society of Gynaecological Oncology Guidelines for the Management of Patients with Vulvar Cancer - Update 2023.

whyItFits: 2023 ESGO guideline for patients with vulvar cancer: staging, groin assessment, sentinel nodes, and treatment of primary and recurrent disease.
limitations: Open PMC full text of the vulvar guideline. Vaginal cancer is named in a keyword string but management recommendations for vaginal cancer are not in the extracted body, so those MCQs were not written.
